No ambient transaction wrapper exists in the inspected endpoint bodies. In normal HTTP use that read's autocommit transaction ends before later insert, allowing a distinct withdrawal between balance decision and spend. Same-request idempotency, one-open-shift uniqueness and ordinary account checks are counterevidence against broader claims, but do not close a distinct withdrawal/receipt race.
